confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and city context; no live menus, listings, or booking pages were inspected, and no web search was used for city prices. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately reliable; July accommodation is least certain given peak-season price swings. Cocktail and wine were set from their typical premium over the beer anchor (about 2.9x and 1.5x) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX value came from RBA-domain search results; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Western European capitals with heavy tourism and broadly similar price levels, such as Brussels, Paris and Copenhagen. Restaurant and drink anchors sit mid-to-upper within that group, and accommodation reflects Amsterdam's high July demand.
